decisions.claim: B is going to the hospital
decisions.reason: Turn 5's 'will also take you to the hospital' presupposes B is going to the hospital; the word 'also' implies an alternative route to the same destination B is heading to.

decisions.claim: B would need to walk two miles to catch a number 13 bus
decisions.reason: Turn 9 explicitly states 'You'll have to walk two miles to catch one' directed at B regarding the number 13 bus.
'B is named Jane' is semantically equivalent to 'B's name is Jane' (c1); same evidence, same entity, same claim.

decisions.claim: B asked whether they needed to take a specific bus to the hospital
decisions.reason: Turn 5's 'No, you needn't' presupposes B asked whether they needed to take a specific bus; this is a valid conversational presupposition from A's response.

decisions.claim: If B takes the number 13 bus, B will have to walk two miles to catch it
decisions.reason: Turn 9's 'You'll have to walk two miles to catch one' is a conditional statement about what B would need to do if taking bus 13; slightly more complete than c3 by making the condition explicit.

decisions.claim: B is going to visit an ill person at the hospital
decisions.reason: Turn 3 'I saw her yesterday. She was a little better.' is A's statement about a third person. It does not establish that B is visiting an ill person at the hospital; the connection between 'her' and B's hospital visit is speculative.
decisions.counterexample: A could be discussing a mutual acquaintance unrelated to B's trip, or 'her' could refer to someone B is not visiting.

decisions.claim: B asked whether the number 7 bus goes to the hospital
decisions.reason: Turn 7 'Yes. I caught a number 7 bus yesterday, and they said I had taken a wrong bus.' is A's own experience. It does not presuppose that B asked whether bus 7 goes to the hospital; A is simply sharing a personal anecdote in response to something unknown.
decisions.counterexample: B could have asked about bus routes in general, or about A's own travel experience, not specifically whether bus 7 goes to the hospital.
